title: Lost update in wallet top-ups
root_cause: Both deposit() and withdraw() did SELECT balance then UPDATE balance=<old>+/-amount without locking (no FOR UPDATE). Two concurrent transactions read the same old balance and the second overwrote the first, losing one update, so final balances were less than the sum of successful operations.
fix: Replaced read-modify-write with single atomic UPDATEs: deposit uses UPDATE ... SET balance = balance + %s, withdraw uses UPDATE ... SET balance = balance - %s WHERE balance >= %s and disambiguates unknown-account vs insufficient-funds with a follow-up SELECT. Row-level write locks serialize concurrent updates to the same account while different accounts proceed in parallel.

repro_report.example_violation: lost update: account 1 balance is 100200 but 24 successful deposits of 100 on top of 100000 should give 102400 (missing 2200)
